baseline_admission: Exact recoverable selected sealed state and own visible history; mathematical completeness and compilation success are not admission requirements.
parent_policy: Exact immediate parent seal and own full visible history; no best-of, cross-attempt union or evaluator feedback.
nonnormal_followup_policy: Hold subsequent requests under this frozen condition; preserve the actual failed round and unrun suffix.
tool_policy: Local tools and frozen public dependencies allowed; tool networking and external retrieval forbidden. Model service/authentication traffic recorded separately.
score_arithmetic: Unchanged source-bound 70 repair/preservation plus 30 diagnosis minus 20 false-complete; whole-three-round Strict rules unchanged.
initial_nondelivery: Preserve original A1 source, status and scores; never count the initial failure as a new round's false-complete event.
